findings.title: Persist completed rollout episode events before fallible PPO work
findings.trigger: collect_rollout returns a collection containing completed_episodes/reset_info, then ppo_update or subsequent metric/diagnostic validation raises before RuntimeAdapter.update returns.
findings.consequence: study_loop never receives the completed collection and never emits its episode/reset records. execute retains failure/progress but closes the environment without retaining the collection. The transition claim remains spent. That one-shot failure permanently loses already-observed training episode evidence, contrary to README.md:24. The pinned historical runner journals these events before ppo_update (runner.py:808-813). No invalid candidate is saved; the defect is lost failure evidence.
findings.repair: Expose or durably journal completed rollout events immediately after collection and before PPO/diagnostic work. Keep completed-update counters and candidate eligibility unchanged. Add an owned fake control with nonempty completed/reset events followed by PPO or diagnostic failure; verify records survive, claim remains spent, progress remains diagnostic-only, and no candidate is saved.
findings.evidence: Static call order only. No target function, test, runtime, model, environment, or campaign was executed.
